CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/access field (origin) and a separate status/organization distinction co-occur for the same referent/time, with literal evidence.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the same content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content labels (red, blue) together with coordinate sets for named referents.

D.rationale: Content entries (color coordinate sets) are presented separately from origin/status metadata for the same referents.

O.rationale: The report states how the content instance is organized/presented/accessible via explicit origin/represented_time fields.
